notes: Table 1 must be joined to table 0 on Material code to build one output record per SKU (12 records, 1:1 on Material code).

Material code is displayed with leading zeros (000001 etc.) although profiled as numeric; it must be read as text so /sku keeps its original zeros.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Material' is a product master: 12 rows, one per material, with a unique code column (12 distinct of 12 rows, e.g. 000001, 000002) and a human-readable product description per code (e.g. 'Coffee variant 01', 'Shampoo variant 02'). This is the only table carrying product names, so it supplies the required /sku and /product_name fields.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Unique per row (12 distinct/12 rows), sku_like hint, values 000001–000012. Leading zeros are present in the source, so the code must stay text and keep the zeros. Values repeat as the join key in the 'Sales units' sheet, confirming it is the item identity.

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Free-text label describing the item brand/type plus variant number ('Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11', 'Shampoo variant 02', 'Tea variant 12'); unique per material code, matching the master-list description required by /product_name.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Sales units' is not a row-per-product master: it is a per-material unit assignment/attribute table (Material code → Unit code) that must be joined to the Material sheet on Material code. It carries no product name and no price, stock or promotion data, so it is best classified as an auxiliary 'other' table supplying the selling unit for each material.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Same format and range as the Material sheet's code (000001–000012, one row per material, distinct=12). Used here as the join key to the product master rather than a separate identity.

columns.name: Unit code
columns.reason: Header 'Unit code' and a single constant value 'BT' in all 12 rows point to a selling-unit code for every material, but 'BT' is an unexplained abbreviation (possibly bottle, but nothing in the workbook states it). The contract requires a full unit name and says codes need source evidence or human confirmation, so this mapping stays provisional pending the meaning of BT.
